'''Sharlu Greslin''' was an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Swamp trooper|mudtrooper]] who held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[corporal]]. He was unable to afford tuition at [[Shey Tapani University]], and opted to serve a second tour in the military in exchange for a scholarship.<ref name="Solo Guide" />
